 Cleveland hosts Oklahoma City on Monday, aiming to make it four wins in as many home games this season.
 Feb 22, 2026; Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, USA; Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell (45) goes up for a basket as Oklahoma City Thunder forward Jaylin Williams (6) defends during the second half at Paycom Center. Mandatory Credit: Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images
 How to watch Thunder vs Cavaliers 
 Date: Monday, November 2, 2026
 Time: 7 PM EDT
 Channel: NBC Sports Network
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Back-to-back losses have seen Oklahoma City lose ground in the Western Conference ahead of Monday night’s visit to Cleveland. The Thunder started the new NBA season with four straight wins but suddenly look vulnerable following wide defeats on the road to Dallas and Houston.
 The Cavaliers will hope to capitalize by clinching what would be their first win in his head-to-head series since January 2025. And Kenny Atkinson’s side have a proud home record of their own to defend after already overcoming Brooklyn, Washington and Minnesota (in OT) at the Rocket Arena this season.
 The Cavs carry an identical 4-2 record in the Eastern’s Central Division entering Monday’s matchup after getting back to winning ways in Milwaukee on Saturday. While back-to-back MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander continues to shine for OKC despite recent wobbles, Cleveland has thrived largely on the backs of star trio Donovan Mitchell, James Harden and Evan Mobley, with few injury concerns at present.
 The same can’t be said for Thunder coach Mark Daigneault, who is missing Chet Holmgren (knee), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Jalen Williams and Alex Caruso (both ankles). Add to that the day-to-day status of Thomas Sorber (knee) and Nikola Topic (back), and it could be another tough day at the office for the travelling team.
